leverage.exposure: This is the one thing to watch. Nothing is leveraged right now — the balance is positive and the banked matchday is safe. But if the live offer wins tonight the balance goes sharply negative the moment it settles, and a negative balance at the start of a matchday scores zero for that entire matchday, which outranks every other consideration in this briefing. The unwind is a single sale and the deadline is the next lock, a full week away, so there is time and no need to act in the middle of the night. The margin, however, is thin: after the sale the balance lands barely above zero, so if the funding leg's value falls before he is sold the single sale stops clearing. Sitting at ten is never the answer. Note also that the ceiling is not merely mechanical: a larger, multi-leg unwind would raise nominal buying power but would cost the eleven more points than the extra money could buy, so bidding past it is a loss even when it looks affordable.
